claims: As of April 2026, John Ternus is 50 years old.
John Ternus was born in May 1975.
John Ternus has been appointed to succeed Tim Cook as Apple's CEO on September 1, 2026.
John Ternus has been a senior vice president of hardware engineering at Apple since 2021.
Tim Cook took over as Apple's CEO in 2011.
Tim Cook was 50 years old when he took over as Apple's CEO in 2011
